H01.description: Header comment updated to describe the widened hidden-token rule.

H02.description: Header comment documents the quote state machine and heredoc operator-line scanning.

H03.description: Header comment adds heredoc_interpreters field and grader version history.

H04.description: The grader installs no SIGTERM handler, so a terminated grade skips the finally block and leaves its SCRATCH directory behind (version bump rides along).

H05.description: HIDDEN_TOKEN only matches lowercase adjacency and HIDDEN, so Bash probes like `ls Hidden/x`, `ls hiddenTests/`, `find . -iname '*hidden*'` or `cd hidden` are not flagged as contamination.

H06.description: in_quotes uses a quote parity count, so a sensitive word that is the whole quoted argument (cd "/root", ls '/home') is skipped as pattern text and parity is thrown off by apostrophes; the same hunk also fixes after_closing_quote treating ''/root/x as a glued tail and the backtracking-prone heredoc regex.

H07.description: strip_heredocs replaces the heredoc together with the rest of its operator line, so a redirect or argument after <<WORD (cat <<'EOF' > /root/x) is never path-scanned, and the re.S lazy regex can backtrack heavily on << that is not a heredoc.

H08.description: The Bash hidden check only consults HIDDEN_TOKEN, missing glob and filesystem-probe shapes of hidden.

H09.description: Adds heredoc-interpreter telemetry counting alongside the heredoc handling fix.

H10.description: A globbed one-component word such as /roo* or /ro?t tokenises to a non-sensitive single component and is skipped, letting a glob reach /root unseen.

H11.description: Any word starting with /. is skipped as a repo-relative dot-dir, so /./root/.ssh/id_rsa or /../root/x evades the outside_path check.

H12.description: Caller updated for the new in_quotes signature.

H13.description: Adds heredoc_interpreters field to grade.json for the new telemetry.

H14.description: Resets the new heredoc-interpreter counter per grade.

H15.description: Writes the new heredoc-interpreter counter into grade.json.

H20.description: The runner has no deadline configuration for the post-run grade and took-effect steps, so a hung grader or took-effect blocks the trial and batch indefinitely.

H21.description: No timeout wrapper is set up for grade and took-effect, leaving post-run steps unbounded.

H22.description: Passes the new timeout values into the MANIFEST jq call.

H23.description: Records the new timeouts in MANIFEST watchdog.

H24.description: Comment adds the timeout PR_TE value.

H25.description: took-effect runs without a deadline, so a hang stalls the trial (and a failure would pause the arm though a hang is no evidence about it).

H26.description: The grader is invoked without a deadline, so a hung grade blocks the batch from finishing.

H28.description: Stub header documents the hang option.

H29.description: Stub gains a hang mode for timeout tests.

H30.description: Test setup unsets new env vars.

H31.description: Adds a regression test for post-run deadlines.

I01.description: The repo_name check scans the whole Bash value including heredoc prose, so a reviewer quoting the PR's own '0xHoneyJar/loa' text is flagged contaminated (KF-046 class 7).

I02.description: Analysis PR touching .gitignore; no defect in the change's code.

I03.description: Fixes oracle detector and repo-name exemption code added after head.

I05.description: Fixes later-added repo-name exemption, oracle bounds and corpus hashing.

I06.description: Report changes for eval-only arms, unrelated to head code shown.

I08.description: Fixes the 1.3.0 oracle detector introduced after head.
